closed_hat.basis: license-clean fallback -- rendered isolation failed for this voice (every take in all_takes failed the usability bar)
closed_hat.provenance: license-clean fallback one-shot (CC0 1.0): TR-808 closed hi-hat HC25 from tidalcycles/Dirt-Samples, retrieved 2026-11-08 from raw.githubusercontent.com (URL verbatim from the Recall sample-sources reference). Rendered isolation failed for this voice -- 8 MusicGen takes across 3 prompt strategies, none a struck hit (every take a slow-rising sustained texture; envelope peaks at 0.7-2.8 s, no attack transient anywhere in the field) -- so the founder's fallback clause stands this sample in its place. Measured by the house scales on arrival: single hit region, 0.175 s decay, tail -69.7 dB rel peak, sustain -70.9 dB, decays fully within the file. Its tonality reads 0.925: that is the TR-808 hat's own metallic partial stack (six fixed square-wave oscillators), not melodic bleed -- stated so the number is never mistaken for the failure it convicted in the rendered takes.

sigma.note: no Sigma layer was generated or mixed; there is no sigma.wav in this run directory, by design. The founder's A/B question — what the track is without the ground — is answered by this file and no other change.

notes: VARIANT of v4-proof-3: the single difference is the ABSENT Sigma layer; the validation block proves the bed under this mix is the bed under v4's, sample for sample.
loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the proof build, stated not hidden).
section levels RMS-matched to the median section, clamped to +/-6 dB, before crossfading.
2 s tail fade + 5 ms head fade applied before mastering.

stereo law: the spine is panned by role, the bed is widened by quadrature side synthesis above 180 Hz with the mid preserved exactly and the lows left fully mono. In v4 the Sigma layer stood outside that law, never processed; in this variant there is no Sigma layer to exempt.

spine: SAMPLED KIT — rendered one-shots placed by resonance.studio.spine, ZERO synthesis; provenance in the spine block's kit manifest (the kit itself lives in v4-proof-3 and is referenced, not copied).
arpeggio: the house's composed violin layer, as v4; its notation stands in composition.abc.
